newsitem.title: ITALY: Antonini confirmed as EU shipyards body chairman.
newsitem.headline: Antonini confirmed as EU shipyards body chairman.

text.p: Corrado Antonini, chairman of Italian state-controlled Fincantieri, has been confirmed as chairman of the Committee of European Shipbuilders' Associations (CESA) for the fifth consecutive year, a statement from Fincantieri, part of the IRI group, said.
CESA groups about 260 shipyards with a total workforce of just over 76,000.

The statement said the confirmation of Antonini's appointment, made during the latest CESA meeting held in Turku, Finland, gave "continuity to the line followed so far by CESA, especially with regard to the negotiation for the re-establishment of normal competitive conditions on the world shipbuilding market."
Antonini is also Chairman of the Italian National Shipbuilding Industry Association (ASSONAVE).
